findings.body: The doc comment lists four valid strings: `off`, `low`, `medium`, `high`. Because the field is `String`, any arbitrary value compiles and is accepted at runtime. Callers that pass a typo or unsupported value will see a silent no-op or an error from the API only at inference time, not during config parsing. The field should use an enum or be validated in the config deserializer.
findings.title: Validate `reasoning_effort` is one of the documented values

lookups.why: Confirm the struct definition, the location of fallback/max_tokens, and whether there is any existing field-level validation logic in this file.

value.summary: Adds a `reasoning_effort` field without validating its value or enforcing that it is only set when the model supports reasoning. This can silently produce ineffective or failing model calls.
